BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP2023)
CLASS: IMSc    SEMESTER : IV
BRANCH:QEDS    SESSION : SP2023

SUBJECT: ED219 ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND DEMOGRAPHY
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1(a) Describe poverty. [2] CO1
Q.1(b) Explain why poverty line in India is estimated using consumption expenditure method. [3] CO1


Q.2(a) Describe  the  three  dimensions  of  Gender  Development  Index  and explain  its
calculation.
[2] CO1
Q.2(b) A country’s “Human Development Index” is 0.434. Its Life Expectancy Index is 0.578
and Income Index is 0.323. Calculate the Education Index for the country.
[3] CO1


Q.3(a) Explain the Trade-offs among the three main objectives of Sustainable Development. [2] CO1
Q.3(b) Derive   the   Harrod-Domar   model   of   economic   growth   (incorporating   capital
depreciation).
[3] CO2


Q.4(a) Using the Harrod-Domar model, explain how foreign  investment can lead to higher
growth rates for a developing economy.
[2] CO2
Q.4(b) Derive  the  equation  of  motion  of  capital  for  Solow  model  (incorporating  capital
depreciation).
[3] CO2


Q.5(a) Explain the Golden rule level of capital in Solow model. [2] CO2
Q.5(b) In India, an increase in capital of Rs. 5.13 lakh crore is required for an increase in
output  of  Rs.  2.32  lakh  crore.  How  much  would  the  rate  of  savings  have  to  be  to
achieve a GDP growth rate of 12% in Harrod-Domar model? Take depreciation rate of
3%.
[3] CO2
